source_contract: Client fixes identity and SPR. Retained official API has no skill descriptions. Selected L1J NPC mobskill/npc/skills rows define separate LOCAL backend policy, never Classic original confirmation.
range_semantics: TriRange negative=max distance; positive=min distance. Physical Range and positive skill ranged constrain maximum. Area metadata is retained independently from selected target execution.
selection_semantics: mobskill actNo order; TriRnd is per-candidate chance with earlier selected actions preventing later selection; on_hit poison runs only after landed physical attack
summon_semantics: SummonMax is random width, not upper count. Config MaxServantSummons=100 is source cumulative servant cap; normalized runtime lifecycle/cap must be explicitly reported.
status_semantics: Poison1 30s to PC, 3s tick5; poison2 until cure; poison4 delayed20s then paralysis45s. paralysis_atk alone intentionally omitted.

official_web_search.result: No supporting official monster-specific behavior description found; community board posts and remaster data excluded.
